statement: Controls that stay live in the typed catalog but no longer head a cascade root: their selection reaches the runtime as data, not as a CSS channel. A retired id may keep neither a root cell nor a row in the cascade catalog.

roots.reason: --ds-experience-profile lost its only emissions: the selection travels as runtime data. The control still produces its four distributed channels, none of which is a root head.
--ds-recipe-profile lost its only emissions and the recipes deriver was deleted: the selection travels as runtime data and the control produces no channel.
